author: KomodoLord1
body:
Map Name: Sletche Kaart ( Don't translate if you know the right language lol)
Builders: Czco and KomodoLord1
XML: Need somebody!
Download: Soon!
Images: https://imgur.com/a/hL0TC
Team Colours: Lime and Pink
Team size: Maybe 12v12 or 10v10 (Opinions)
Type of Map: CTF (Get it in rots again!)
Map Changes: Tunnel under map is there, changed ugly floor to a random pattern of clay dark and light green (ty for idea Rilo), extra archer nest added (small), Flag is only enterable from front but can exit from two sets of mini-staircase once in (in XML enemies wont be able to enter flag part), despite many concerns of the sharp 5 swords at mid I didn't say that they are on low durability so can only be used once and when you have armour it will deal about half health NOT a free kill.
Hope you enjoy, I want all helpful feedback as we appreciate that there may be some issues we haven't noticed!
Thanks! 
PS: On the opinion of map size Coco and I have decided to keep it the same size to make it unique compared  to many current large maps, we appreciate some people want it to be bigger, however, we also have people who like this feature and like how it is sized.If this becomes an issue which stops it from being accepted we are open to change, but not until that point.
